question: Did the Falcons pick the right captains for this season, or not?

stances.renee-vaughn: While the Falcons selected a defensible slate of seven captains covering every unit, the confirmed facts don't tell us if they were the 'right' choices.
stances.big-mike-vega: The Falcons absolutely nailed it by selecting seven captains who cover every unit and embody the championship energy this team needs to dominate.
stances.andrew-hammond: The Falcons made a sound decision appointing a diverse group of leaders representing all key units, a textbook approach to fostering team identity and leadership.

withheld.instruction: Detonate the claim that the role of a captain is to represent the identity of the Atlanta Falcons.

waypoints.note: Directly challenge Renee's uncertainty about 'right' choices.
Reframe Big Mike's 'championship energy' as 'fostering team identity'.
Introduce the idea that 'leadership comes in many forms' to question the captain structure.
Push back on Renee's doubt by emphasizing the representation of units.

attribution.label: SOURCED & COMMITTED
attribution.law: When a receipt is an ATTRIBUTED_CLAIM, name who said it and where (person/outlet + platform), then COMMIT to your read of it - never hedge it into mush. A FACT you state plainly. Never present an unproven claim as settled fact; never bury a real fact under "allegedly".

detonation_react.instruction: React with surprise to Renee's point about identity, then defend by linking it to the chosen captains.

kk_drop.instruction: Take the floor for your ONE weight-drop: name the thing the others have been circling without seeing. Two or three sentences, NEW words only, unhurried, air around it. End by reframing the question itself.

opener.instruction: The Falcons named seven captains covering every major unit, which is sound structure.

exit.instruction: Concede nothing; tease that the real test is on the field.
